_about: H2/H8 Wash, stitch, plaster (docs/archive/clinic/clinic-design-v1.md, quality pass Q4 and Q5). The reference healing game for docs/architecture/clinic-heal-api.md (js/clinic/heal/games/cut.js). Real Kutchi only where it exists: pela, ne poi, paani, the numbers hakro/ba/trae/char/panj, wadho/nindho. Everything in [brackets] is an English placeholder (grey italic on screen). Level 1 is taught (the first-ever healing game: three one-word steps, said one at a time, the tray in that order); from level 2 the counts, the plaster's colour and (level 3) the order by size are the ear rows.

cut-why.e: I fell over and scraped my arm.
cut-why._src: moved out of the game's code into its data so the engine holds it (step 4e, G26); English placeholder, to record

cut-goal.e: Let's clean it and put plasters on.
cut-goal._src: moved out of the game's code into its data so the engine holds it (step 4e, G26); English placeholder, to record

camera._about: D2 (1 Oct): the wide shot the zoom starts from, chosen by the angle the close-up needs (front-on or side-on). No side-on sitting pose exists yet: 'side' uses the front pose until the art batch (art list A1).
camera._target: A1 (5 Oct): the match cut. target = where the close-up draws the sore part and size = its radius, in the close-up's 800 x 500 units: the push-in ends with the patient's part (from the art's anchor) at that place and size.

art._about: heal-A, 2 Oct: the close-up art swaps in by file name (docs/design-language/art-plans/clinic-heal-art-plan.md § 8). The code draws the stand-in until `on` is true; the cut session sets `on` once the file exists. box = where the picture sits, in the close-up's svg units (800 x 500).

cloth-dab.why: S1, CLN-99: the cloth in the hand while dabbing (art run s02)

forearm-graze._a1: A1 (5 Oct): the plain F1 is the arm (the game draws the graze); its wrist (950, 460 in the source) at (510, 350), so the fingers end before the tool column (CLN-74), the sleeve off the left edge. kinds: as the knee. size, tip and wrist (source px) let the game slide it so the fingertips end before the tool column on every screen.

knee-graze._a1: A1 (5 Oct): the game draws its own graze, dirt and plasters, so the plain K1 is the limb (K3's graze would show twice); its knee's front (950, 390 in the source) at (440, 350), so both plaster patches (x 235 and 385) sit on bare skin. kinds: the child limbs' cloth is white (the girl's leggings) until the fabric tint is built.
